title: Consultancy Services for FWD Testing, Road Inventory (NSV) and CBR Investigations for CRIF Works 2026–27
location: Bengaluru, Malavalli, Mangaluru, Tumakuru and Hassan, Karnataka
description: Consultancy services for conducting Falling Weight Deflectometer (FWD) tests, Network Survey Vehicle (NSV) road inventory surveys, California Bearing Ratio (CBR) investigations and other applicable pavement evaluation studies for the preparation of various road works approved under the Central Road and Infrastructure Fund (CRIF) for the year 2026–27 across the following locations: Bengaluru Sub-Division, Malavalli Sub-Division, Mangaluru Sub-Division, Tumakuru Division and Hassan Division, Karnataka.
